mentions.name: AI-native multi-tenant SaaS PHP framework
mentions.description: A custom PHP framework powering an AI-native multi-tenant SaaS with zero vendor dependencies and no Kubernetes, Docker, or CI vendors. It runs in production on a Hetzner shared host with a closed-loop self-healing pipeline: APM/WAF/logger critical alerts trigger a Telegram message with analyze/ignore buttons, tapping it opens GitHub where an AI routine drafts a pull request for human review; after merge it snapshots the DB and git sha, deploys via git reset --hard in 0.6 seconds, and a queue worker runs a 5-minute health check. It also includes an EU AI Act registry that auto-discovers AI systems, GDPR features, statistical (not %-delta) performance regression detection using Mann-Kendall, Theil-Sen, and Cohen, and per-domain database routing.
